caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur with a brown leather strap and backing. The spur features a wheel with pointed rays (rowel) at one end, which is dark gray in color, and is attached to a U-shaped band adorned with circular holes along its side. The leather strap is reddish-brown with a basketweave pattern and covers part of the metal band, with a loop for fastening. Additionally, there is a small round metal button or ornament visible on the leather, which is a dull gold color, and a piece of light-colored material (possibly bone or horn) attached to it. The background is plain and off-white, and the objects are rendered realistically, occupying the center of the image. The artist’s signature, “R.W.A. Taylor,” is located in small letters on the lower right side of the drawing.
title: Spur
